decision-row.eventDescription: One domain dispute case: provider, case number, policy, case name, every disputed domain with its TLD, complainant and respondent with their domiciles, the outcome in the provider's own words and normalised to who won, the decision and filing dates, the proceeding language and the link to the published decision.

search-request.eventDescription: One request to a provider: a FORUM search or a page of a Czech Arbitration Court grid. Never charged for more requests than the run wrote rows.

decision-document.eventDescription: Optional. The published decision opened and read, which is one extra request per case. Charged only when the document came back.

parsed-decision.eventDescription: Optional. The registrar, the panelists and the panel size, the relief sought and ordered, the per-domain outcome, the default and dissent flags, the reverse domain name hijacking finding and the reasoning sections. Charged only when the document yielded them.

case-timeline.eventDescription: Optional. Filing date, response deadline, response received date, the date the decision was signed and the days from filing to decision. Charged only when the document carries the dates.

party-representatives.eventDescription: Optional. Counsel and law firm for the complainant and the respondent. Charged only when the decision names at least one of them.

decision-text.eventDescription: Optional. The whole decision as plain text with its word count, 2,000 to 6,000 words a case. Charged only when the text came back.
